# AutoLustre — Car Detailing Sydney

## Business Summary
AutoLustre is Sydney's premier professional car detailing studio, servicing vehicles across the Sydney Metropolitan area from our dedicated 6-bay studio in Alexandria, NSW. Founded in 2017 by IDA-certified detailing technicians.

## Services
- Signature Detail — Full interior and exterior reset, from $249, 3 hours
- Paint Correction — Multi-stage machine polishing, from $549, 1 day
- Interior Revival — Deep cabin extraction and leather conditioning, from $189, 2 hours
- Ceramic Protection — 9H ceramic coating with 5-year warranty, from $899, 2 days
- Exterior Detailing — Full-panel exterior treatment, from $179, 2 hours
- Interior Detailing — Deep cabin steam and extraction, from $199, 2.5 hours
- Paint Protection Film — Self-healing TPU film on high-impact zones, from $1,299, 3 days
- Ceramic Coating — Professional 9H hydrophobic coating, from $799, 2 days
- Maintenance Wash — Routine touchless hand wash with coating boost, from $99, 1 hour

## Credentials
- International Detailing Association (IDA) Certified
- Gtechniq Certified Installer (one of fewer than 40 in Australia)
- Gyeon Master Detailer
- 4.9★ average across 380+ verified Google reviews
